command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd "$HOME/head-row"; ROW="$PWD/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh"; FX="$PWD/evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs"; P="$HOME/probe"; 
mk() { local n="$1"; [ -d "$P/$n" ] && find "$P/$n" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null; [ -d "$P/$n" ] && rmdir "$P/$n"; cp -a "$FX/runs/a1-build" "$P/$n"; }
go() { local n="$1"; shift; out="$("$ROW" --run-dir "$P/$n" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" "$@" 2>&1)"; rc=$?; printf '%-40s rc=%s  %s\n' "$n" "$rc" "$(printf '%s' "$out" | head -c 300)"; }
mk g1; echo '{"recall": 0.5, "hidden_tests": null}' > "$P/g1/grade.json"; go g1
mk g2; echo '{"verdict_accuracy_per_gate": "x"}' > "$P/g2/grade.json"; go g2
mk g3; : > "$P/g3/grade.json"; go g3
mk g4; echo '[1]' > "$P/g4/grade.json"; go g4
mk g5; echo '"str"' > "$P/g5/grade.json"; go g5
mk g6; echo '{"hidden_tests": "7/8"}' > "$P/g6/grade.json"; go g6
mk g7; echo '{"false_positives": {"n": 1}}' > "$P/g7/grade.json"; go g7
mk g8; echo '{"regressions": 2, "verdict": "APPROVED"}' > "$P/g8/grade.json"; go g8
mk e1; jq '.metadata = "x"' "$FX/runs/a1-build/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-review.json" > "$P/e1/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-review.json"; go e1
mk e2; jq '.verdict_quality = "DEGRADED"' "$FX/runs/a1-build/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-review.json" > "$P/e2/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-review.json"; go e2
mk e3; echo '{"verdict_quality":{"voices_planned":"2","voices_succeeded":1}}' > "$P/e3/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-review.json"; go e3
mk m1; echo '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","payload":"oops"}' > "$P/m1/eval/model-invoke.jsonl"; go m1
mk m2; printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","payload":{"effort_effective":"high","calling_primitive":"x"}}' > "$P/m2/eval/model-invoke.jsonl"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/m2" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" | jq -c '[.degraded, .degraded_reason, [.phases[]|select(.label=="REVIEW")][0].effort_effective]'
mk p1; jq '.started = ""' "$FX/runs/a1-build/meta/pipeline.json" > "$P/p1/meta/pipeline.json"; go p1
mk p2; jq '.started = "2026-10-22T18:18:43.123456Z" | .finished = "2026-10-22T18:18:45+00:00"' "$FX/runs/a1-build/meta/pipeline.json" > "$P/p2/meta/pipeline.json"; go p2
mk p3; jq '.phases[2].models_used = {}' "$FX/runs/a1-build/meta/pipeline.json" > "$P/p3/meta/pipeline.json"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/p3" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" | jq -c '"p3 empty models_used degraded=\(.degraded)"'
mk p4; jq '.phases[2].model_requested = null' "$FX/runs/a1-build/meta/pipeline.json" > "$P/p4/meta/pipeline.json"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/p4" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" | jq -c '["p4",.degraded,.degraded_reason]'
mk p5; jq '.status = "weird"' "$FX/runs/a1-build/meta/pipeline.json" > "$P/p5/meta/pipeline.json"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/p5" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" > "$P/p5.jsonl"; jq -r '"p5 status=\(.status)"' "$P/p5.jsonl"; "$ROW" --validate "$P/p5.jsonl" --allow-ungraded; echo "rc=$?"
mk p6; jq 'del(.phases[2].modelinv_lines)' "$FX/runs/a1-build/meta/pipeline.json" > "$P/p6/meta/pipeline.json"; go p6 | cut -c1-80
mk t1; : > "$P/t1.yaml"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/t1" --task-yaml "$P/t1.yaml" 2>&1 | head -c 200; echo " t1 rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
mk mf; : > "$P/mf.json"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/mf" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" --manifest "$P/mf.json" 2>&1 | head -c 200; echo " mf rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
mk a1; echo '{"arm_map":{"abl-fixture-a1_full-bf-01-t1":"a0_bare"}}' > "$P/a1.json"; find "$P/a1/meta" -name arm -delete; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/a1" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" --manifest "$P/a1.json" | jq -r '"manifest-vs-pipeline.json disagree -> arm=\(.arm)"'
echo "--- attempts edge:"; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/a1" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" --attempts 007 | jq -c .attempts; "$ROW" --run-dir "$P/a1" --task-yaml "$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" --attempts 0 | jq -c .attempts
